shipped_rows.title_o: Academic and Behavior Combined Support: Evaluation of an integrated supplemental intervention for early elementary students

blind_target.evidence_quote: The purpose of this research was to conduct a practice-based replication of Academic and Behavior Combined Support (ABC Support), a previously developed and experimentally evaluated supplemental intervention that merges a combined focus on reading fluency and academic engagement.
blind_target.outcome_quote: In concert with prior empirical findings on ABC Support, analyses revealed improvement from baseline to intervention for both reading and behavior outcomes, as well as from baseline to follow-up assessments.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly compare the new improvements with prior ABC Support findings as being in concert. The abstract does not identify the original bibliographic entry.
